text:
Ivy (AE): Heads up — CobaltMed procurement paused PO. They need a clean MSA+DPA+order form before PO, insist on customer-managed keys (BYOK/HSM), SCCs for transfers, and they only accept signatures through their auth'd tool SignFlowX. cc @Drew @Priya :wave

Marco (SE): Which deployment? Hosted vs Dedicated matters for BYOK support.

Ivy (AE): Dedicated in eu-west-1 for PHI. They want HSM attestations and ability to import keys via PKCS#11. Also asked to pin models for 90 days.

Drew (Legal): Send redlines and their sample SignFlowX audit log. We usually can accept third-party e-signers if audit log + signer authority provided.

Ivy (AE): Uploaded redline here: https://files.example/cobaltmed/dpa_redline.pdf and the SignFlowX sample: https://files.example/cobaltmed/signflowx_audit.pdf

Marco (SE): Tech notes: our HSM gateway supports PKCS#11, AWS KMS, GCP external KMS. BYOK import documented — customer controls rotation. I'll paste a short KMS blurb for the appendix: "Customer retains sole control of key material; Redwood processes wrapped keys per KMS appendix; access to key usage metadata is logged and auditable."

Drew (Legal): I'll avoid absolute phrasing like "sole control" — will reference APP-KMS-2026 and require the appendix + logging obligations. They redlined liability cap to unlimited for data breaches — we need to push back and offer a carveout for gross negligence only.

Priya (Finance): For EU invoicing: which billing entity? They asked invoices to go to CobaltMed EU B.V. in NL. We need VAT ID and billing address. Also confirm currency (EUR) and whether they want annual upfront or monthly. AR prefers annual prepaid for Dedicated.

Ivy (AE): Procurement said: annual commit, invoice EUR to NL, PO pending once docs are clean. They also asked SLA 99.95% and 1 hour response for sev1.

Drew (Legal): 99.95% is ok to discuss for Dedicated, 1 hour response is tight. Proposal: 1 hour on-call notification + 4 hour mitigation SLA with capped credits in order form. I'll draft credit cap language (max 10% monthly). Need SRE signoff for response SLA.

esig-checker-bot: SignFlowX review checklist: (1) audit log with signer IP/time, (2) proof of authority for signer, (3) tamper-evident PDF. Attach docs when returning signed order. See: https://internal.redwood/esign-policy

Marco (SE): Also CobaltMed asked about model pinning guarantee for 90 days. Operationally we can support pinned Major.Minor for 90 days; must add exception for emergency security patches.

Drew (Legal): I'll add model-pinning clause: "Customer may request Major.Minor model pin for up to 90 days; Redwood will not change pinned model without 30 days notice except for security/emergency updates."

Priya (Finance): Once Legal posts clean docs, AR can accept SignFlowX-signed PDF provided audit log meets policy and PO number included. We'll need to map EUR invoice to NL entity in our accounting and confirm VAT handling. Net30 standard; they requested net45 — escalate if needed.

Ivy (AE): Action items:
- Drew: clean MSA+DPA+order form + APP-KMS-2026 reference + SLA credit wording + model-pinning clause by EOD CET
- Marco: attach BYOK/HSM deployment checklist and confirm PKCS#11 steps for their infra
- Priya: prepare invoice template for EUR/NL entity and check net45 exception path with AR
- Ivy: ask procurement to confirm VAT ID, billing address, and whether SignFlowX signed PDF will be the source-of-truth

Drew (Legal): Will draft and post links here. If SignFlowX audit log looks good, I'll include an e-sign acceptance clause conditioned on the attached audit evidence.

Marco (SE): I'll drop the deployment checklist now: https://playbooks.redwood/dedicated-byok-checklist and note the supported KMS endpoints.

Ivy (AE): Procurement replied — they'll provide VAT and billing address after Legal sends clean DPA. Sounds like they'll only countersign once we accept SignFlowX. I'll nudge them for PO timing.

Priya (Finance): Confirmed: billing@redwood must be cc'd on signed order. AR needs PO to match invoice for recognition. I'll await the clean doc to confirm net45 exception.

Ivy (AE): Thanks team — I'll update when procurement sends VAT/PO. :white_check_mark:
